label: Estimated adjusted mutation score
definition: Estimated specified-layer killed-mutant proportion after design-weighted equivalent-mutant adjustment; not an exhaustive exact score.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Mutation generation efficiency (score per second)
definition: Estimated adjusted mutation score divided by self-reported total generation time in seconds.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Test smell density
definition: Confirmed (eligible source test, smell type) pairs divided by eligible source tests times seven frozen smell types.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Syntax error rate
definition: Syntax-error pytest items divided by generated pytest items.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Runtime error rate
definition: Runtime-error pytest items divided by generated pytest items.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Function error rate
definition: Function-error pytest items divided by generated pytest items.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Statement coverage
definition: Statements covered by valid participant tests divided by measurable statements.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Branch coverage
definition: Branches covered by valid participant tests divided by measurable branches.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Assertion score
definition: Eligible source test functions with a non-trivial SUT-related oracle divided by eligible source test functions.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Generation time (seconds)
definition: Self-reported total task time, including comprehension time, in seconds.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Execution time (seconds)
definition: Median wall-clock seconds from 15 fresh pytest-process measurements of valid participant tests.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Statement generation efficiency (coverage per second)
definition: Statement coverage divided by generation time in seconds.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Branch generation efficiency (coverage per second)
definition: Branch coverage divided by generation time in seconds.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Statement execution efficiency (coverage per second)
definition: Statement coverage divided by median execution time in seconds.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Branch execution efficiency (coverage per second)
definition: Branch coverage divided by median execution time in seconds.
missing_value_rule: NA when undefined; never replace with zero in the primary analysis.

label: Mutation execution efficiency (score per second)
definition: Estimated adjusted mutation score divided by median execution time in seconds.
